composition_subtypes.role: DP over current number of warriors
Sort portal importance descending to defend best ones

payload.core_composition_summary: DP on warrior count with greedy selection of top portal importances to defend per castle.
payload.rationale: Solution uses DP to track max importance given warriors after each castle, and for each state greedily picks top importance from portals sorted descending. DP and greedy are interleaved.
